dash.title: EU Wallet Demo Dashboard
dash.subtitle: Try the EU Digital Identity Wallet end to end: verify a PID, receive attestations and present them to four relying parties.
dash.multi.off: University: two requests in a row
dash.how.title: How it works
dash.how.1: Present your PID (OpenID4VP) to sign in or register.
dash.how.2: Receive attestations in your wallet through a QR code or deeplink (OpenID4VCI).
dash.how.3: Present those attestations to other relying parties.
dash.issuer.title: Local demo issuer
dash.issuer.desc: An OpenID4VCI issuer (pre-authorised code flow, SD-JWT VC) that issues demo PIDs, birth certificates and the bank attestations. An external issuer can be connected by configuration.
